_comment: The ONLY place product facts live. build.py substitutes {{key}} in every page and in llms.txt, and refuses to build if a page hardcodes a price. Change a price here, rebuild, done. Verified 2026-09-30: prices via `asc iap/subscriptions pricing summary` (USA); free allowance = Store.swift freeAllowance; iOS floor = project.yml deploymentTarget.
definition_en: Untouched is an iPhone app that keeps byte-for-byte copies of the photos and videos you choose, in its own folder on your iPhone, so storage optimization can’t swap them for low-resolution previews.
definition_zh: Untouched 是一款 iPhone App：把你选中的照片和视频的原始文件逐字节复制到它自己的文件夹里，让系统的储存空间优化没法把它们换成低清预览。
